answer: KYC Completion Rate fell 30.1% over the 7 days to 31 August 2026. The reading was 0.49 against an expected 0.7, a fall of -0.21. It is graded a warning rather than urgent. Detected against forecast band+mad. I am tracking 5 metrics for this tenant, of which 5 are governed contracts with an owner and a lever list: KYC Completion Rate, Loan Approval Volume, Revenue, New Account Signups, Transaction Failure Rate. The movement in KYC Completion Rate is most concentrated in the North America region, at 13.6% of the total. Behind it: the Europe region (9.9%), branch SB-205 (8.5%), branch EU-024 (6.5%) and branch NA-005 (5.1%). Localised by psqueeze.
